items.title: Carlyle, KKR Get Ready to Snatch Up Bargain Loans
items.summary: Carlyle Group Inc., KKR & Co. and Oaktree Capital Management are among the money managers hoping to pounce on US leveraged loans increasingly selling at bargain prices.
